taxonomy_authority: AlgoCore editorial taxonomy, derived from QP tasks and MS criteria; not an official Cambridge classification.

levels.topic: Broad subject area, not a question type.
levels.skill: Transferable action such as comparison, pointer update or parsing.
levels.pattern: Repeatable task boundary with distinctive recognition and required behavior.
levels.variant: Source-dependent representation, pointer convention, ordering, algorithm form or constraint.
levels.task_mode: What the candidate must produce: declaration, implementation, completion, translation, adaptation, integration, output or evidence.

patterns.name_vi: Khai báo và khởi tạo dữ liệu thông thường
patterns.name_en: Declare or initialise general scalar/array storage
patterns.recognition_vi: Đề yêu cầu biến, mảng hoặc giá trị ban đầu theo dữ kiện; trạng thái riêng của ADT dùng dạng setup tương ứng.
patterns.boundary_en: General arrays/scalars, fixed supplied data; use specific ADT setup for stack/queue/list/tree/hash.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Marks require the array identifier and the ten given integer values.
Global array structure(s), appropriate field types and eleven-element capacity are required.
MS separately requires the local2D array and random initialisation of every cell; those separable requirements support both tags.
The only required mark is array declaration with100 Picture elements; constructing business-data instances is not independently required by this row.

patterns.name_vi: Khai báo cấu trúc bản ghi
patterns.name_en: Declare a record-like field structure
patterns.recognition_vi: Khai báo các trường và kiểu dữ liệu theo TYPE/record; class chỉ là phương án thay record nếu ngôn ngữ cần.
patterns.boundary_en: QP asks for TYPE/record fields, allowing a class as a language substitute. If QP explicitly asks for an OOP class and constructor, use OOP_CLASS regardless of visibility or class name.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The named record and its two integer fields are assessed; a Python class here substitutes for a record, not an encapsulated business object.
Record or record-substitute class contains string ID and integer quantity.
Declare RecordData with string ID and integer Total.
Queue record/class contains one integer array and two integer pointer fields.

patterns.name_vi: Thêm phần tử vào mảng còn chỗ
patterns.name_en: Append a record/value to bounded array storage
patterns.recognition_vi: Kiểm sức chứa rồi ghi vào vị trí trống kế tiếp và cập nhật số lượng; chưa yêu cầu duy trì thứ tự sắp xếp.
patterns.boundary_en: Check capacity, write next slot, update count; distinct from ordered insertion and ADT enqueue.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The procedure checks capacity, stores a job at the next available row and increments count; it neither inserts into sorted position nor changes queue head/tail pointers.

patterns.name_vi: Chèn vào bảng đã có thứ tự
patterns.name_en: Insert into an already ordered table
patterns.recognition_vi: Đưa phần tử mới vào bảng đang có thứ tự và giữ giới hạn top-N; không tự áp đặt một thuật toán sắp xếp cụ thể nếu đề không yêu cầu.
patterns.boundary_en: Shift/position a new score or record in sorted storage; not sorting the whole input.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Find the insertion position and store existing/incoming name-score pairs correctly while retaining a top-ten list; QP does not name insertion sort or mandate a named sorting algorithm.

patterns.name_vi: Tạo dữ liệu mảng ngẫu nhiên
patterns.name_en: Generate random array data
patterns.recognition_vi: Sinh đủ số phần tử trong khoảng quy định; có thể phải loại trùng hoặc khởi tạo mảng nhiều chiều.
patterns.boundary_en: Populate array with random values; uniqueness, bounds and dimensionality are variants.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: MS separately requires the local2D array and random initialisation of every cell; those separable requirements support both tags.
Create a local 1D array with twenty distinct random integers0..100; all three requirements have explicit marking criteria.

patterns.name_vi: Đọc file vào mảng, bản ghi hoặc ADT
patterns.name_en: Read text into arrays/records or an ADT
patterns.recognition_vi: Đọc và tách dòng, đưa dữ liệu vào cấu trúc được giao; lời gọi Push/Enqueue/AddNode có sẵn là context.
patterns.boundary_en: Read/parse lines, populate a data structure; invoked ADT operations belong to context unless implemented in this row.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The procedure opens/reads the file, stores each name-score pair, closes the file and may gain the stated file-handling criteria; no ordering algorithm is implemented here.
The procedure reads100 integer values into existing storage and handles file exceptions; it does not search or sort.
Read every line into the array with file opening, closing and error-handling credit.
Read all IDs with file handling and call Enqueue for each value.

patterns.name_vi: Đọc file để tạo hoặc cập nhật đối tượng
patterns.name_en: Read data and construct or update objects
patterns.recognition_vi: Mỗi bản ghi xác định đối tượng/loại con, hoặc dùng khóa để tìm và cập nhật đối tượng hiện có.
patterns.boundary_en: Construct object records, dispatch subclasses or locate/update existing objects from file records.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Read question/answer/points groups, construct TreasureChest objects and store them in arrayTreasure; array declaration and object creation are explicit criteria alongside file handling.
The30-element object array, per-record object construction and file reading/storage are explicit marking requirements.
Read records, create/store one Picture per record, handle the file and count/return objects; array declaration is prior context, not newly assessed storage setup.
Read records, create/store one Picture per record, handle the file and count/return objects; array declaration is prior context, not newly assessed storage setup.

patterns.name_vi: Ghi hoặc nối dữ liệu vào file
patterns.name_en: Write or append data to a text file
patterns.recognition_vi: Tạo các dòng đúng định dạng, dùng chế độ ghi phù hợp và xử lý lỗi khi được yêu cầu.
patterns.boundary_en: Output file records and stated error handling; read/write modes and provided/new file differ.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The procedure opens the new output file, writes the top ten in the stated field order and closes it; it does not read a missing input file.
Append all array values to the parameter filename, one per line, with exception handling.
Write all physical TreeArray rows as comma-separated triples to new Tree.txt with exceptions.

patterns.name_vi: Tìm phần tử bằng duyệt tuần tự
patterns.name_en: Find an element by sequential search
patterns.recognition_vi: So sánh tuần tự để tìm giá trị, vị trí hoặc tồn tại; nếu phải đếm mọi lần khớp thì dùng dạng đếm.
patterns.boundary_en: Return existence/index/match, possibly retry input; frequency uses COUNT_OCCURRENCES.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The function accepts the search value, examines array elements and returns true when found or false when absent; it does not count occurrences.
MS distinguishes searching names through GetName, handling case, repeating failed user choices and retaining the matched position.
Read hours, locate employee by number using its getter, and call SetPay for week one.
Find the chosen tree and calculate years from its starting height, maximum height and annual growth.

patterns.name_vi: Đếm số lần thỏa điều kiện
patterns.name_en: Count matching data items
patterns.recognition_vi: Đếm mọi phần tử/ký tự khớp trong dữ liệu; cách lặp hay đệ quy là biến thể, không dựa vào tên hàm.
patterns.boundary_en: Count repeated matches, characters or values; iterative/recursive implementation is a variant.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: MS requires input range/type validation, scanning all100 entries, incrementing a count for each match and returning the total; FindValues is not an existence-only search.
Loop over all elements, count matches and return the count.
Preserve supplied vowel-counting algorithm with loop, first-character check and string reduction.
Recursive empty-array base case and matching/nonmatching recursive returns on reduced array.

question_context.split_constraint: four semicolon-terminated statements; no built-in split

patterns.name_vi: Lọc tất cả bản ghi thỏa điều kiện
patterns.name_en: Select all records/objects satisfying conditions
patterns.recognition_vi: Chọn mọi bản ghi/đối tượng đáp ứng các điều kiện kết hợp, thường có nhiều thuộc tính cần so.
patterns.boundary_en: Multiple conditions, case rules and reporting matches; not a single-key search.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Input three constraints, check all three against each loaded object through getters and output every match; this is conjunctive filtering, not one-key existence search.
Input three constraints, check all three against each loaded object through getters and output every match; this is conjunctive filtering, not one-key existence search.
Compare all three requirements, retain matching Tree objects and report matches or no suitable tree.

patterns.name_vi: Gom khóa và cập nhật tổng theo nhóm
patterns.name_en: Group repeated keys and update per-key totals
patterns.recognition_vi: Tìm nhóm đã tồn tại để tăng tổng, hoặc tạo nhóm mới; không chỉ tính một tổng chung.
patterns.boundary_en: Find existing group or create one and accumulate its count/value.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Dequeue one ID, search existing groups, increment its total or append a new group.

patterns.name_vi: Sắp xếp nổi bọt
patterns.name_en: Implement bubble sorting
patterns.recognition_vi: Cài đặt so sánh và đổi chỗ các phần tử kề nhau; giữ đúng chiều, khóa và phạm vi của vòng lặp.
patterns.boundary_en: Sort via adjacent comparisons/swaps; direction, dimensions, key order and comparator are variants.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: MS distinguishes loop limits, comparison direction, swap assignments and preserving the supplied bubble-sort logic; general translation is not a separate algorithm pattern.
The nested dimension/pass/comparison loops and adjacent swap implement the supplied row-wise sort; no general unnamed-algorithm tag is added.
The row writes bubble-sort loops/swaps, outputs the sorted contents and calls the new procedure from main; sorting is the concrete primary operation.
Complete missing statements and preserve supplied loops and first-character access.

patterns.name_vi: Sắp xếp chèn
patterns.name_en: Implement insertion sorting
patterns.recognition_vi: Lấy phần tử kế tiếp, dịch phần đã có thứ tự và chèn đúng chỗ; không nhầm với chèn một mục vào bảng top-N.
patterns.boundary_en: Grow ordered prefix by extracting and shifting; recursive/iterative and record-key variants.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The procedure grows the ordered prefix by comparing priorities and shifting/inserting the complete job pair; this differs from appending a job and from sorting job numbers.
Follow supplied recursive insertion structure, base case and inner shift loop.
Extract each next item, shift larger prefix elements and insert ascending without built-in sort.

question_context.search_form: iterative or recursive accepted by MS; QP requires binary search

patterns.name_vi: Tìm nhị phân trong mảng đã sắp
patterns.name_en: Search a sorted array by interval reduction
patterns.recognition_vi: Tính vị trí giữa, thu hẹp cận và trả vị trí hoặc sentinel; cần phân biệt bản lặp với bản bắt buộc đệ quy.
patterns.boundary_en: Iterative/recursive variants, bounds, midpoint and sentinel; tree search is TREE_SEARCH.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Six completed statements, function parameters/recursive calls and the supplied integer-division logic are assessed; source defects are preserved, not endorsed.
Iterative interval reduction, midpoint checks and index or minus-one return.
Use four parameters, recursive bound changes, matching midpoint return and not-found base case.
Reduce sorted-array bounds, return middle index or -1; no built-in search.

question_context.search_form: iterative or recursive accepted by MS; QP requires binary search

patterns.name_vi: Khởi tạo stack và con trỏ
patterns.name_en: Declare or initialise stack state
patterns.recognition_vi: Khai báo mảng, sức chứa và vị trí top theo đúng quy ước đề cho.
patterns.boundary_en: Array capacity, values and top convention; general record declarations may be separate.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Global StackData with ten integer slots and zero-initialised StackPointer are explicitly assessed.
Two string arrays with capacities 20 and 10 and both top pointers initialised to zero.
Declare both named arrays with 100 letter slots each.
20 string slots and current-top pointer -1.

patterns.name_vi: Viết thao tác Push
patterns.name_en: Implement push
patterns.recognition_vi: Kiểm đầy, cập nhật top và lưu giá trị theo đúng thứ tự của quy ước con trỏ.
patterns.boundary_en: Capacity test, pointer/index convention, write and result.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Check capacity, store at the next-free pointer, advance it and return success; this row implements Push rather than merely calling it.
Check full, store data, advance next-free pointer and return Boolean success.
Classify a supplied letter as vowel or consonant, push into that stack, handle full and advance its top.
Full condition, increment top, store string, return integer -1 or1.

patterns.name_vi: Viết thao tác Pop
patterns.name_en: Implement pop
patterns.recognition_vi: Kiểm rỗng, lấy giá trị và cập nhật top; kiểu sentinel là một phần của giao diện hàm.
patterns.boundary_en: Empty case, read and pointer update; exact sentinel/type is a variant.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: MS distinguishes empty sentinel, access to the current top, pointer decrement and returned removed item.
Check empty, return top item and decrement pointer; empty returns empty string.
Implement both pop functions with empty detection and pointer decrement.
Return string -1 when empty; read current top and decrement.

patterns.name_vi: Phối hợp hai stack và hoàn trả phần tử
patterns.name_en: Coordinate two stacks with restoration
patterns.recognition_vi: Lấy một cặp phần tử; nếu chỉ một bên có dữ liệu phải khôi phục phần tử chưa ghép được.
patterns.boundary_en: Pop paired items and restore the unmatched one when the other stack is empty.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Pop both items, output a pair when available or restore the unmatched item and message.

patterns.name_vi: Rút dữ liệu từ stack để tính kết quả
patterns.name_en: Consume stack values to compute a result
patterns.recognition_vi: Dùng Pop lặp lại để tính biểu thức hoặc tìm cực trị; không chỉ gọi Pop vài lần rồi in.
patterns.boundary_en: Repeated pop with arithmetic/min/max; not merely calling Pop twice.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Repeatedly pop alternating operators/numbers and maintain calculated total.
Pop until empty while finding maximum and minimum, then report both.

patterns.name_vi: Khởi tạo queue và trạng thái
patterns.name_en: Declare or initialise queue state
patterns.recognition_vi: Khai báo mảng/record, head, tail và count nếu có; phải giữ queue vòng hay tuyến tính theo đề.
patterns.boundary_en: Linear/circular, array/record wrapper, head/tail/count conventions.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The ten-element string queue and all three zero-initialised state variables are required.
QP requires appropriate initial pointers; MS gives head=-1/tail=0 as an example. No circular wrap or item counter is specified.
Five sale-record slots, empty record initialisation and head, tail, count set to zero.
Declare 50-string queue, head minus one and next-free tail zero.

patterns.name_vi: Viết thao tác Enqueue
patterns.name_en: Implement enqueue
patterns.recognition_vi: Kiểm đầy, thêm phần tử, xử lý phần tử đầu và cập nhật con trỏ/count; chỉ quay vòng khi đề yêu cầu.
patterns.boundary_en: Full handling and queue pointer/count updates, including wrap when specified.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: MS assesses completed queue indices/full return/count update plus function structure and reference-state handling, preserving circular wrap.
MS distinguishes tail capacity, append/advance, success return and initial head update; circular wrapping is not part of this operation.
Check full, insert at tail, wrap tail, increment count and return status.
Check full, insert at tail and increment it; set head for the first item.

patterns.name_vi: Viết thao tác Dequeue
patterns.name_en: Implement dequeue
patterns.recognition_vi: Kiểm rỗng, lấy dữ liệu FIFO và cập nhật trạng thái; reset/wrap và việc giữ dữ liệu vật lý phụ thuộc đề.
patterns.boundary_en: Empty handling, read and pointer/count updates, preserving stored slots when required.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The function handles empty state, retrieves at head, updates head with wrap and decrements count; published example inconsistencies are not silently treated as correct variants.
Return empty record when empty; otherwise advance/wrap head and decrement count.
Empty gives a message and Empty string; otherwise return head data and advance head.
Return string false when empty or return next data with head update.

patterns.name_vi: Xem các phần tử queue mà không lấy ra
patterns.name_en: Read current queue contents without removing items
patterns.recognition_vi: Duyệt phạm vi dữ liệu đang sống và trả/in nội dung, không thay head/tail hoặc giảm count.
patterns.boundary_en: Follow live range for concatenation/output; not physical whole-array display or dequeue.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Concatenate the live queue range beginning at head, without removing data.

patterns.name_vi: Xử lý hoặc cộng dồn dữ liệu queue
patterns.name_en: Consume or recursively process queue data
patterns.recognition_vi: Đọc các phần tử của queue để tích lũy; có thể rút qua Dequeue hoặc xử lý bằng đệ quy theo đề.
patterns.boundary_en: Accumulate/process queue values; group-by and RLE also have their own assessed tags where implemented.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Rewrite the supplied iterative queue-total computation recursively, with base case, recurrence and returned sum; queue removal is not required.
Create queue then repeatedly dequeue until sentinel and accumulate all returned integers.

question_context.pointer_convention: head first item, tail last item, initial -1/-1; no wrap

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: Consume queue, compare consecutive digits, count each run and append digit/count to global string.

question_context.compression_assumptions: at least one digit; no run greater than9

patterns.name_vi: Khởi tạo linked list và free list
patterns.name_en: Initialise linked-list and free-list storage
patterns.recognition_vi: Tạo head, các liên kết và vùng trống theo bảng/mô hình; có thể là mảng hoặc object references.
patterns.boundary_en: Record/2D array or object linked representation, head/free links and null conventions.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

evidence_examples.ms_distinguishing_requirement: The array of node records, all supplied field values and both initial pointers are assessed.

LinkedList constructor creates a null HeadNode.

patterns.name_vi: Duyệt linked list theo liên kết
patterns.name_en: Follow linked-list links to output data
patterns.recognition_vi: Đi từ head qua next để đọc/in theo thứ tự logic, không theo chỉ số mảng vật lý.
patterns.boundary_en: Logical list order, not physical array order.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.

Create a Node from integer data, link it to previous head, replace head.

patterns.name_vi: Xóa node khỏi linked list
patterns.name_en: Remove a linked-list node
patterns.recognition_vi: Bỏ node khớp yêu cầu, cập nhật link/head và trả node về free list khi cấu trúc yêu cầu.
patterns.boundary_en: First occurrence, head/middle/tail cases, presence assumptions and free-list recycling.
patterns.skill_scope: Candidate skills vary by source part; map skill_tags are a narrow index, analyst_skill_tags and MS basis retain further detail. Neither is a separate scored rubric.
